case_search_note: Linked from the court's Online Case Information & Court Calendar page: 'Search and view case information or view the current court calendar.' The page says nothing specific about criminal case access or whether documents are viewable.

courthouses.name: Lakeport Courthouse (Lakeport Division)
courthouses.hours: Building, counter and telephone: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Main courthouse (new building at 675 Lakeport Blvd.; older court pages still show 255 N. Forbes St.). Hears felony and misdemeanor criminal matters, in-custody arraignments (Dept. 3), juvenile, family, civil, probate, mental health. Veterans Court is held in Lakeport 1st and 3rd Wednesdays. Department assignments from the court's Courtrooms page as of 2026-10-13 — they rotate.

departments.label: Department 2
departments.type: Felony (prelims, sentencing, law & motion, settlements); misdemeanor evidentiary hearings and settlements

departments.label: Department 3
departments.type: In-custody arraignments; juvenile detention; probate/LPS/guardianship; civil harassment

departments.label: Department 4
departments.type: Misdemeanor arraignments and law & motion; warrant returns without attorney; juvenile dependency/delinquency; mental health (firearms relief, CARE)

courthouses.name: Clearlake Branch
courthouses.hours: Counter and telephone: Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. (excluding holidays)
courthouses.note: Traffic and non-traffic infractions (incl. traffic trials), small claims, unlawful detainer, DCSS child support, and Drug Court (Commissioner). No misdemeanor/felony calendars listed here. Drug Court day conflicts on the court's own page (Clearlake Tue 4 p.m. vs. Lakeport Wed 4 p.m.).

public_defenders.name: Lake County Public Defender
public_defenders.note: County office established by the Board of Supervisors in 2023 (previously indigent defense was contracted to private attorneys). Mailing: 55 First Street, Box D; administrative office 255 N. Forbes St. The court's Criminal Division page still lists 255 N. Forbes St.
public_defenders.todo: Hours, email, and the current conflict-counsel arrangement (alternate defender/contract) not published

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Ukiah Office (serves Lake County)
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Lake and Mendocino counties (civil legal aid)
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid; services list includes Clean Slate (criminal record clean-up such as expungement). Not criminal defense on open cases.

probation.name: Lake County Probation — Lakeport Office (Adult Division incl. Pre-Trial Supervision)
probation.note: Pre-Trial Supervision Unit monitors people ordered onto supervision by the Superior Court while awaiting trial. Administrative office: 255 N. Forbes St., Lakeport.
probation.todo: Hours not listed; county directory also mentions Lower Lake (9055 Hwy 53) and Clearlake offices — not confirmed on the Adult Division page

programs.name: Probation Pre-Trial Supervision
programs.summary: Probation's Pre-Trial Supervision Unit monitors people the court orders onto supervision while awaiting trial. Conditions depend on your release order.

programs.name: Drug Court
programs.summary: Listed on the court's Courtrooms page under the Clearlake Commissioner's calendar (Tuesdays 4 p.m.); the same page's 'About Calendars' section says Lakeport, Wednesdays 4 p.m. Confirm with the court. Eligibility details not published.
programs.todo: Resolve day/location conflict; eligibility not published

programs.name: Veterans Court
programs.summary: Held in Lakeport on the 1st and 3rd Wednesdays of the month per the court's Courtrooms page. Eligibility details not published.

jails.name: Hill Road Correctional Facility (Lake County Jail)
jails.houses_note: Sheriff's jail pages do not state it; the county's 2005/2006 Grand Jury report (lakecountyca.gov archive) says the jail houses both men and women with a female dorm. Dated source.
jails.phone_note: Visit reservations (Housing Unit B and Booking, non-contact, 24h ahead): (707) 262-4240 ext. 6, Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. Other pods have fixed visiting days by pod. Sheriff main line (707) 262-4200.
jails.money_note: Access Corrections online/app, phone 866-345-1884, or 24/7 kiosk in the Jail Booking Lobby (cash or card). Money orders not accepted.
jails.court_ids_note: Court's Courtrooms page puts in-custody arraignments in Dept. 3, Lakeport; the Sheriff does not state transport routing.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — verify any bail agent's license. Lake County Sheriff's Bail Information page: bail may be posted in full cash or through a licensed bail agent; bail amounts and court dates appear on the booking sheet from the inmate search. The page does not state the payment location or hours.
